reviewerRole: Independent evaluator; post-runtime semantic document reviewer
reviewType: Semantic understanding against neutral mission/conformance intent and universal-v01.json; not runtime evaluation

criteria.quote: Any-Shape preserves comprehensible information, authorized operations and trust as form, geometry, resources, input and medium change. Browser resizing is an example, not the mission.
criteria.observation: Explicitly distinguishes enduring information/operations/trust from one geometric stimulus.

criteria.quote: Both channels use one validator and dispatcher, including permission, strict parameters, consent, revision conflicts and actor-scoped retry keys.
criteria.observation: Describes shared domain semantics for browser/human and newline JSON/agent channels; prose does not itself establish implementation parity.

criteria.quote: The stable surface is surface.preferences; its fields are field.display-name and field.density and its mutation is action.apply.
criteria.observation: Identifies stable semantic IDs, transient displayName, density enum, initial state, and failure/retry invariants matching neutral fixture.
Explicit boundary; named principals described as trusted fixture infrastructure rather than production authentication.

criteria.quote: Desktop, editor/3D and universal platform support remain proposed/unknown.
criteria.observation: Explicitly limits proof to preferences, excludes production authentication and durable persistence, and distinguishes migration from historical drop-in compatibility.

criteria.quote: an optional decoration module whose disappearance leaves plain semantic HTML plus a separate terminal renderer.
criteria.observation: Explains replaceable appearance/diagnostic mechanisms, native semantic fallback and separate presentation; this does not prove arbitrary dependency/platform reconstruction.

criteria.quote: Functional parity, human accessibility, aesthetic quality and historical drop-in compatibility are separate judgments.
criteria.observation: Separates fixture proposals from ratified policy and names unknowns; blind-isolation and preimplementation-authoring claims remain author statements, not verified facts.

overall.scope: Written understanding coherently covers the seven specified semantic criteria; not a universal application or source-compatibility approval

unverifiedClaims.reason: Understanding says written before implementation; this review was performed after runtime evaluator completed and does not independently establish authoring chronology.
Shared filesystem and procedural instruction; author self-report is not a technical source-denial guarantee.

limitations: Reviewed understanding is not runtime proof, complete accessibility proof, aesthetic approval or historical CSS/ESM/schema compatibility.
No candidate implementation source, candidate self-tests or original test code read.
Review cannot establish guaranteed blind isolation or independence of underlying agent training/context.

runtimeReportRelationship.note: Runtime report deliberately deferred semanticUnderstanding to parent/human review. This separate post-runtime review supplies that external semantic result; runtime runner did not review understanding.
